description: This file defines the Template class responsible for rendering HTML templates using the Plates engine, including navigation building, translation, and rendering functions.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class responsible for managing HTML template rendering, navigation, and translation functions using the Plates engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Template object with a configuration.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Creates or returns an existing Plates engine instance configured with template directories and theme.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a specified template with provided data, augmenting the template data with configuration and page info.

methods.name: registerFunctions
methods.description: Registers custom functions for use within templates, such as navigation and translation helpers.

methods.name: renderNavigation
methods.description: Recursively renders a navigation menu from directory entries.

methods.name: buildNavigation
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical navigation structure from a directory tree.

methods.name: getSeparator
methods.description: Returns a separator string based on the provided label, such as chevrons.
